title: Suicide Silence covers 'Blind' by Korn LIVE
contentHtml:
Suicide Silence covered Korn’s song ‘Blind’ at a benefit show in Santa Ana, California on December 4th. Suicide Silence has always been Kornfans which is quite obvious when you look at their album “The Black Crown” which has the song ‘Witness The Addiction’ that had Korn’s vocalist Jonathan Davis featured on it. Eddie and the crew did seem to kill it with the cover, I mean I sure dig it. Suicide Silence then proceeded to cover Montell Jordan’s song ‘This Is How We Do It’ after ‘Blind’ because why not do two covers in one night, right?
YouTube user Concert_Dude_88 managed to capture some of the glory from that night but he did sing over it while recording, prepare your ears at least he didn’t hold the phone vertical.

​
